picks.detail: Zapier documents the actions available to its agents through connected applications. Start with a reversible step such as creating a draft. Give the agent two records with similar names, watch which one it selects and check whether an operator can see the inputs that led to that choice.

Copilot Studio is a candidate when staff already work inside Microsoft tools. Its documentation explains how agents combine knowledge and actions. Have two employees with different permissions ask about the same internal document. Capture the response and the underlying access settings before connecting an action that can edit records.

IBM describes agents in watsonx Orchestrate for business workflows. Ask for a trial that hands a task from one team to another. Stop it immediately after a downstream action succeeds, then resume it. Count the records created and check who can resolve the run when a dependency is unavailable.

methodology: Compare CRM, ERP, cloud and cross-app workflows by the systems each option supports. Evaluate implementation services separately from software platforms.
commercial_relationship: The publisher sells AI implementation services.
questions: Give each vendor the same ten representative tasks and record which actions complete correctly.
Repeat the test as a user with fewer permissions. Check both data visibility and write access.
Interrupt a workflow halfway through. Inspect retries, duplicate records and the human handoff.
pricing: Ask for a quote at your expected task volume. Include platform seats, model calls, action or connector charges and human review. Divide the total by successfully completed tasks.

firms.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
firms.note: Provides tools to build agents. Test access with two employees who have different permissions on the same document.

firms.name: Salesforce Agentforce
firms.note: Runs agents on the Salesforce platform. Ask which CRM records an agent can update and how those changes appear in the audit trail.

firms.name: Google Cloud Agent Builder
firms.note: Provides services to build and manage agents on Google Cloud. Budget for the people who will operate the deployment.

firms.name: Amazon Bedrock Agents
firms.note: AWS restricts Agents Classic to existing users. New buyers should evaluate AgentCore. Existing users can test model-driven actions with a narrowly scoped account.

firms.name: SAP Joule Agents
firms.note: SAP describes agents for business processes. Check whether your target transaction and SAP edition are supported.

firms.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
firms.note: Offers agents for business tasks. Ask for a demo using the same applications and access rules your users have.

firms.name: Workato Agent Studio
firms.note: Builds agents that work across business applications. Compare the cost and permissions of the connectors you need.

firms.name: Zapier Agents
firms.note: Uses configured actions in connected applications. List the steps that should still require human approval.

firms.name: UiPath
firms.note: Combines agents with process automation. Test an exception that needs a person to resume the workflow.

firms.name: Capgemini
firms.note: Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask how the team handles process exceptions.
